title: Elecktra Bionic wins Drag Race Italia Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (IT-S01-E06), Elecktra Bionic, Farida Kant, and Le Riche lip-synced to Loredana Bertè's "Non sono una signora". Elecktra Bionic was crowned the winner without ever winning a maxi challenge or lip-syncing before the finale, with Farida Kant and Le Riche as runners-up.

title: Ivana Vamp: Italia's first Porkchop
summary: Ivana Vamp was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Italia (IT-S01-E02), losing the lip sync to "Comprami" against Le Riche.

title: Enorma Jean disqualified
summary: After swearing at and insulting production backstage, Enorma Jean and Ava Hangar were both put up for a punishment lip sync to RuPaul's "Champion" in IT-S01-E04. Ava Hangar won and remained in the competition, while Enorma Jean was disqualified outright.
